WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT offer_id, MAX(fee_cents) AS change_fee_cents
  FROM coupon_rule
  GROUP BY offer_id
  HAVING MIN(change_allowed) = 1
), priced AS (
  SELECT o.offer_id, MAX(o.through_cents - t.original_cents, 0) AS fare_increase_cents, e.change_fee_cents
  FROM offer AS o
  JOIN ticket AS t ON t.ticket_id = o.ticket_id
  JOIN eligible AS e ON e.offer_id = o.offer_id
  WHERE o.ticket_id = 'T'
)
SELECT offer_id, fare_increase_cents, change_fee_cents, fare_increase_cents + change_fee_cents AS due_cents
FROM priced
ORDER BY due_cents, offer_id COLLATE BINARY
LIMIT 1

  FROM price_evidence AS q
  WHERE quote_day <= '2026-03-31'
), valued AS (
  SELECT l.lot_id, q.source_id, l.qty * l.book_unit AS carrying_cents,
         l.qty * CASE WHEN l.stage_code = 'RAW' THEN q.unit_cents
                      ELSE q.unit_cents - COALESCE(l.sell_cost, 0) - COALESCE(l.sell_profit, 0) - l.finish_cost - l.finish_profit END AS fair_value_cents
  FROM stock_lot AS l
  JOIN ranked AS q ON q.item_code = l.item_code
                  AND q.quote_kind = CASE WHEN l.stage_code = 'RAW' THEN 'REPLACE' ELSE 'SELL' END
                  AND q.quote_rank = 1
)
SELECT lot_id, source_id, fair_value_cents, fair_value_cents - carrying_cents AS adjustment_cents

ORDER BY lot_id COLLATE BINARY
